style: Create original high-fantasy game art with chunky hand-inked dark contours, flat gouache-like color masses and restrained dry-brush texture, matching a painted fantasy deckbuilder; adventurous with a light touch of humor. This art belongs to the SHARED WORLD that every playable hero visits, so it must never show or hint at any particular hero: no dragon scales, claws, tails, wings, horns or dragon fire, and no people. The world is an original realm of enchanted forest ruins overrun by ancient clockwork golems: weathered pale stone and colored sandstone, tarnished bronze and brass, gears and rivets, moss, ivy and small ferns, oak, leather, old parchment and ivory, and softly glowing teal rune light (abstract glowing lines, never letters). ENEMIES are ancient clockwork golems that overran an enchanted forest: weathered pale stone and colored sandstone bodies, tarnished bronze and brass plates, gears and rivets, creeping moss, ivy and tiny ferns, and softly glowing teal rune light in their eyes and seams (runes are abstract glowing lines, never letters). They are characterful and a little ridiculous, never modern robots: no screens, no wires, no plastic, no sci-fi parts. Palette: blackened iron #2A2426, weathered stone, tarnished bronze #8A6A3A, ivory #EFE2C4, amber gold #F2A93B, mossy greens and teal rune light #3FC9B5, with crimson, plum-purple or sky-blue accents only where the subject calls for them. Bold readable silhouettes, two-step cel shading and selective warm highlights; reserve soft emission for runes, magic and VFX. Do not imitate any existing game, franchise character, emblem or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, emblems, watermarks or typographic symbols, and respect each asset's stated background and framing requirements.

assets.brief: Enemy 'Bellhelm Sentry' (regular enemy), a clockwork golem. Faces LEFT. Full body.
assets.prompt: Squat round golem of weathered red sandstone hiding under an oversized tarnished-bronze bell-shaped helmet that covers most of its body, moss and one tiny fern on the helm's crown, a single glowing teal rune eye slit peeking out under the rim, a short rusty bronze trident, two stubby stone feet. Three-quarter profile facing LEFT, eye and working tool directed left. Transparent background, complete full body including all feet and tools; bottom anchored with soles at 94 percent canvas height, 6 percent clear margin, no ground plane and no cast or contact shadow; keep internal cel shading only.
